latest.title: Inhomogeneous nonlinear Schrödinger equation in Fourier-Lebesgue and modulation spaces
latest.abstract: The purpose of this work is to provide a broader framework for analyzing the inhomogeneous nonlinear Schrödinger equation (INLS) \[iu_t + u_{xx} \pm |x|^{-b}|u|^{α-1}u=0, \quad 1<α< 5-2b\; \text{and}\; 0< b\leq 1/4.\] Specifically, we establish low-regularity well-posedness in the Fourier-Lebesgue $\widehat{L}^{p}$ spaces for $4/3<p<8$. The analysis is carried out differently for the cases $p<2$ and $p>2$. Primarily, in both cases, we prove global well-posedness for arbitrarily large initial data via the data decomposition method adapted for the Fourier-Lebesgue spaces. Furthermore, we obtain analogous results for INLS in modulation spaces $M^{p,p'}$ for $4/3<p<2$.
latest.workSummary: 论文研究一维色散 Cauchy 问题在 modulation spaces 中的 Lp well-posedness，利用非线性估计和频率局部化建立局部/全局理论。
latest.breakthrough: Theorem C 及后续主定理将已知 Hs/Lp 适定性扩展到 Mp,q。
latest.limitations: 参数 b、s、p、q 需满足文中指数条件；结论按 modulation-space 范数和局部时间区间表述。

steps.claim: Theorem C 确定 modulation-space 目标解空间。
steps.route: Introduction 将线性传播子的频率权重与初值空间配对，明确非线性 Duhamel 映射所需的 Mp,q 正则性。
steps.evidence: PDF 第4–7页，第1节 Theorem C。

steps.claim: Section 3 建立非线性乘积和时间积分估计。
steps.route: 对 dyadic blocks 使用 modulation-space 卷积/乘积界，控制非线性项及其时间局部化后的 Duhamel 积分。
steps.evidence: PDF 第9–18页，第3节 Nonlinear Estimates。

steps.claim: Sections 4–5 通过压缩映射完成 well-posedness。
steps.route: 把线性传播和非线性估计代入迭代映射，证明小时间区间内自映射和收缩，再由连续依赖/延拓得到主结论。
steps.evidence: PDF 第12–19页第4节 Well-posedness in L；第19页起第5节 Well-posedness in L。
